title: Now playing
description: What Music or Spotify is playing, in the menu bar: click it for the track, how far in, play or pause, previous, next and favourite. Reads only a player that is already open, never starts one; with both open the one playing wins, then your pick. macOS asks once per player to let Pilot read it.
examples: The menu bar shows ♫ Daft Punk – Voyager; a lone ♫ while paused, nothing when no player is open
Click it or type now playing: the album, a progress bar, Pause, Previous, Next and Favourite (Spotify: Copy link, as Spotify lets no script like a song)
